decisions.reason: The drink mix is far from the firm's core waste-to-energy and industrial technology knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate consumer food market feedback and improve the product, so it is likely to be dropped.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's existing engineering and waste-to-energy knowledge, enabling it to learn from early results and improve the line, so it is likely to be kept.
As a flagship waste oil-to-energy plant, it closely matches the firm's R&D strengths and strategic direction, allowing the firm to absorb new information and keep the product.
The plastic waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's established knowledge and a strategic focus, enabling it to use its R&D and cooperation to improve the product, so it is likely kept.
